deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -c "if [ \"${AUTO_START}\" = \"true\" ]; then export TS_HOSTNAME=$(echo \"${RAILWAY_PROJECT_NAME}-${RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME}\" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sed 's/[^a-z0-9-]/-/g' | sed 's/--*/-/g') && exec /usr/local/bin/containerboot; fi"

TS_AUTHKEY.description: Tailscale authentication key. Get one from https://login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/keys
clear out auth key in PR environment
